Page 6 — Summary

- Headline/text: States “Regional retention improved.”
- Chart: An unlabeled bar chart titled or captioned not provided. All visible bars appear in the ~70–80% retention range. Because the chart lacks axis labels, numeric tick marks, and a legend, I can only report an approximate range and cannot determine exact values, dates, regions, or the chart’s denominator.
- Photo: A portrait-style photo of an executive is shown.

Identification request
- I cannot identify the person in the photo. I won’t name or guess an unknown individual from an image alone.  
- If you want the person identified, please provide any of: the photo caption/credit from the report, the report’s list of contributors/executives, the image filename/metadata, or confirm that the person is a known public figure and give the name. Alternatively I can describe the person’s visible appearance (non-identifying) or suggest practical steps to confirm identity (check the report credits, image metadata, or contact the report author). Which would you prefer?
